change_rules: A dependency change is a governed architecture change when it affects state, policy, security, durability, or external behavior.
Automatic update tools may open changes but may not merge them without the required evidence.
Transitive dependencies and executable binaries receive the same provenance treatment as direct packages.
No dependency receives Project Pipeline control authority merely because it is adopted.
required_activation_evidence: pinned release, tag, commit, or artifact digest
Windows and AWS compatibility where relevant
